response.rationale: “Visa wisata” is the ordinary Indonesian term, while Malaysian Malay commonly uses “visa pelancong” for a visa intended for tourist visits. Both express the same concept.
response.risk_rationale: Malaysian formal usage may also prefer the derived form “visa pelancongan.”
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Visa pelancongan” may occur in Malaysian formal or institutional usage, but it does not materially undermine the proposed everyday contrast.
